title: 2023年3月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
paperTitle: 2023年3月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
prompt: 随着生活水平的提高，更多人开始加入到自驾游的行列之中。自驾游者既可驾驶自家车也可借车或租车出游。司机可能是车主或结伴出游者。自驾游与传统的组团旅游不同，它能够更好地满足旅游者的个性化需求，使他们更好地享受旅游的过程。自驾游尤其受到年轻出游者的欢迎。年轻人追求独立自由的生活，而自驾游恰好满足了他们的这一需求。
reference: With the improvement of living standards, more and more people are joining self-driving tours. A self-driving tourist can either drive their own car or borrow or rent one for the trip, and the driver may be the car owner or a travel companion. Unlike traditional group tours, self-driving tours can better satisfy tourists' personalized needs and thus help them enjoy the travel experience more fully. They are especially popular among young travelers. Young people pursue an independent and free life, while self- driving tours happen to meet this very need.
